content.title: Arvada Winterfest
content.summary: The 2026 Arvada Winterfest, a free multicultural celebration, will take place on February 28 from 11 a.m. to 4 p.m. in Olde Town Arvada. Attendees are encouraged to participate in a feedback survey for the event, with a chance to win a $50 gift card, and can enjoy various performances, cultural demonstrations, and activities suitable for all ages.
content.body:
## Arvada Winterfest feedback survey

Thank you to everyone who attended the 2026 Arvada Winterfest in Olde Town! [Take our quick survey](https://publicinput.com/winterfest) to let us know about your experience so we can make next year's event even better.

Survey participants have the option of getting entered into a drawing for a chance to win a $50 Olde Town gift card.

### [Winterfest Survey](https://publicinput.com/winterfest "2026 Winterfest Survey")

![Performer in traditional regalia dancing on stage with drummers during a cultural performance.](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=7166)

---

## Arvada's free multicultural winter celebration

Arvada Winterfest is a free, family-friendly event celebrating diverse cultures and traditions. Since starting in 2018, Winterfest has become one of Arvada’s most popular community events.

![](/ImageRepository/Document?documentId=2627)

- **Date**: Saturday, Feb. 28, 2026
- **When**: 11 a.m. to 4 p.m.
- **Where**: Olde Town Arvada Square, 5726 Olde Wadsworth Blvd. [View the Winterfest Event Map](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=7072)

1. [Punch Card Participating Businesses](#tab8eaa3d96-cf3c-4c12-986f-95c36b1df6da_0)

Purchase one item from the following businesses to receive a stamp. Collect five stamps and get entered for a chance to win a $50 Olde Town gift card!

- Rheinlander Bakery
- Hunter Bay Coffee Roasters
- Breadwinner's Cafe
- Arvada Army Navy Surplus
- Carly's Boutique
- Eli Ashby Healing Arts
- Mermaid Walking Boutique
- Outside The Box
- Outside The Box Too
- La Dolce Vita
- School House Libations
- Secret Level
- Ramah Home
- AdiLuna Boutique
- Marmalade Lounge

Pick up your Winterfest punch card at the Arvada Festivals Commission information booth in Olde Town Square.

## Arvada Winterfest returning to Olde Town in 2026

For the second straight year, Winterfest will be held in the Olde Town Square in the heart of Olde Town Arvada!

The layout is similar to Olde Town's Second Saturday Concert Series in the summer, with two stages hosting different performances throughout the event – the Bank Stage (Olde Wadsworth Blvd. and Grandview Ave.) and the Square Stage (W 57th Ave. and Old Wadsworth Blvd.).

[**View the Winterfest event map**](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=7072)**.**

Winterfest features several free activities and performances that are suitable for all ages:

- Live interactive cultural performances and demonstrations
- Live ice sculpting
- Craft vendors and food trucks

### Square Stage

**Land Acknowledgement and Drum Performance**

- [Rocky Mountain Indian Chamber of Commerce](https://rmicc.org/)
- 11 a.m. to 11:30 a.m.

**Interactive African Drum Demonstration**

- [Colorado African Innovation and Culture Center](https://www.caccenter.org/)
- 11:45 a.m. to 12:30 p.m.

**Mariachi Performance**

- [Mariachi Los Correcaminos de MSU](https://roadrunnerlink.msudenver.edu/organization/mariachi-los-correcaminos-de-msu-denver)
- 1 to 1:45 p.m.

**Dragon and Lion Dance**

- [Colorado Asian Cultural Heritage Center](https://usdldf.org/listings/colorado-asian-cultural-heritage-center-cachc/)
- 2:15 to 3 p.m.

**Brazilian Samba Dancing**

- [Samba Colorado](https://www.sambacolorado.com/)
- 3:15 to 4 p.m.

### Bank Stage

**Irish Dancing**

- [McTeggart Irish Dancers](https://www.mcteggart.org/)
- Noon to 12:45 p.m.

**Polynesian Dancing**

- [Kalama Polynesian Dancers](http://www.halaukalama.com/)
- 1 to 1:45 P.M.

**Folklorico Dancing**

- [Fiesta Colorado Dance Company](https://www.facebook.com/fiestacoloradodance/)
- 2 to 2:45 p.m.

**Martial Arts Demonstration**

- [Red Dragon Martial Arts](https://www.reddragonmartialart.com/)
- 3 to 3:30 p.m.

## Arvada Winterfest featured on Inside Arvada podcast

Learn all about the 2026 Arvada Festivals lineup, including what to expect at Winterfest, in this edition of the Inside Arvada podcast. Watch the episode below on YouTube, or listen on [Apple](https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/inside-arvadas-2026-festivals-with-layla-diaz/id1736238466?i=1000746045086) or [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/episode/4y2PVhN0un2l1iucostjaa?si=wfdW2AoRTNyeL0oPQbIh6w).

### Volunteers needed!

The Arvada Festivals Commission is seeking volunteers to help ensure that Arvada Winterfest is a safe and enjoyable experience for everyone. Volunteer shifts are available starting at 7:30 a.m. for set up through 5:30 p.m. for tear down.

### [Volunteer Sign Up](https://www.signupgenius.com/go/20F0445A8A928A0FF2-60975342-winterfest#/ "Winterfest Volunteer Sign Up")

## Where to park for Winterfest

Parking in Olde Town for the festival will be limited, so we encourage everyone to park in the [Olde Town transit hub](/571) or to use alternative modes of transportation.
